annotations.title: Convert a Lichess or chess.com rating

description: Converts one rating between Lichess and chess.com for a time control, from people who play on both sites. Give lichess or chesscom (exactly one) and time_control. Returns the estimate on the other site and the range most people with that rating fall in.

chesscom.description: A chess.com rating to convert to Lichess.

lichess.description: A Lichess rating to convert to chess.com.

time_control.description: Time control. Each site and time control is its own rating pool.
